# RemoteProcessRequest

`schemas/records/remote-process-request.json`

The request of a remote_process effect (docs/design/m0/03 "External effects", 12 "Remote processes"). It is the kind's reconciliation declaration. The kind reconciles from its request, so the request is a blob: the caller publishes its RFC 8785 form in the blob store before the intent, the intent's request_digest references it, and the store refuses the intent while the blob is absent (eventstore EffectKind.RequestBlob). remote_process is not idempotent at its target, so it is never retried. An uncertain one is reconciled by "no process of the recorded sessions remains" under the recorded identity on the target, killing leftovers. Cleanup is part of the target's restore, so a leftover keeps the target's lease unsettled (05 "Evidence-target leases"). Runtime reconciliation is M1 (03).

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `target` | yes | [EvidenceTargetID](common-defs.md#evidencetargetid) | The evidence target, which is also the intent's target. |
| `attempt` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) | The evidence attempt, with its fencing (05). |
| `run` | yes | [EvidenceRunID](common-defs.md#evidencerunid) | The same attempt's id on its receipts (06 Demand.run; D40). |
| `identity` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) | The alias of a recorded identity in the project profile (07), never the remote principal itself. Recovery resolves the alias through the profile to the principal and its credentials when it reconciles. An alias that no longer resolves leaves the effect uncertain, and the target's lease unsettled. |
| `sessions` | yes | array of [Name](records-receipt.md#name) (minItems `1`, unique items) | The session tags, assigned before egress. Every remote process starts under one, so reconciliation finds what remains of each. |
| `deadline_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) | The end of the run's single deadline. Every remote call gets only the time left before it (12). |

No other fields are allowed.
